title: V5: per-block cluster timing JSONL (cross-node, file-locked)
brief: Owner needs one JSONL row per sealed block with a single anchor timestamp (production start) and named wall-clock deltas (ms) to each subsequent step in the RFC16 cluster path (propose → attester RX/process/send → proposer RX attest → gate-ready → seal). Proposer and attester are separate processes: use a shared timing path under repo tmp plus fs2 exclusive lock with blocking wait. Enable via env/CLI; CY lab launchers point both nodes at the same file. Complements post-hoc log parser (review ticket 20260609 parser).

shared_path.note: Must be identical for proposer and attester (not under per-node state-root). Set in cy-cluster-common.ps1: PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_PATH / PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_ENABLED.

lock.policy: exclusive lock on .lock; blocking acquire with bounded timeout (e.g. 30s) then warn+skip write; release on drop

design.correlation_key: (cluster_id, height, round) — round 0 for current lab

anchor.definition: Proposer: wall ms when production for height H starts — first open of grid slot for target_h=H (begin_slot new + record_cluster_prop_tick), or first record_cluster_propose_originated for (H,0) if earlier hook unavailable

d_ms_schema.prop_first_wire_send: t0 → first successful write_wire_msg ClusterPropose to attester peer
d_ms_schema.prop_wire_resend_total: count of propose wire sends for (H,0) — metric, not delta
d_ms_schema.prop_rx_attest: t0 → proposer cluster attest accepted (quorum slice k=1)
d_ms_schema.prop_gate_ready: t0 → first run_cluster_gate Ok for target_h in seal loop (same deadline iteration optional flag)
d_ms_schema.prop_seal_commit: t0 → chain.seal Ok for height H

extra_fields.suppress_strike: bool — slot got suppression strike before seal
extra_fields.attest_timeout: bool — quorum_timeout seen for this height

steps: 1) Under lock: load pending JSON map keyed by 'height:round'.
2) Proposer/attester merge their milestone absolute timestamps (t_*_ms) into pending entry.
3) On proposer seal Ok: compute all d_ms from stored absolutes; append one JSON line to jsonl; remove pending key; unlock.
4) If attester writes after seal (late): append orphan line with flag late_attester=true OR drop with debug log — prefer strict seal-time finalize only.

module_layout.wire: App field BlockTimingCfg; init from CLI/env in main.rs
hooks: peer_session/mod.rs: send_cluster_prop after write → prop_first_wire_send, resend count
peer_session/mod.rs: route_cluster ClusterPropose accepted → att_* on attester role
peer_session/mod.rs: attest wire send path → att_wire_send
lifecycle.rs: run_cluster_gate Ok → prop_gate_ready (once per height)
lifecycle.rs: chain.seal Ok → finalize jsonl row

acceptance_criteria: CY 2-node run with PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_ENABLED=1 produces append-only tmp/cy-lab-block-timing.jsonl with ≥10 lines after short soak
Each line: valid JSON, schema_v=1, t0_ms, d_ms object with all defined keys (null allowed only if step never reached)
Concurrent proposer+attester writes do not corrupt pending/jsonl (manual or unit test with two threads + temp dir)
fs2 lock: second writer blocks then succeeds (test or documented soak)
cy-cluster-common.ps1 (or proposer/attester launchers) sets shared PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_PATH for lab
Unit tests: d_ms derivation from absolutes; pending merge; lock timeout path
cargo fmt/clippy on touched pwmd files
